crossRefs.note: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you…
Yahweh will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to Yahweh, and he will be entreated by them, and will…
Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
